design_description: The AUFA kit is built around a distinctly Parisian identity, combining classic French visual codes with an elegant, almost lifestyle-inspired football aesthetic. The shirt uses a deep midnight navy base, deliberately kept very clean so the graphic elements carry the concept. A vertical French tricolour stripe in navy, white and red runs asymmetrically down the front, interrupted by the AUFA wordmark before continuing toward the hem. The same tricolour treatment is echoed on the polo collar, creating a strong connection between the different elements. The defining illustration is the Eiffel Tower, rendered as a fine white line drawing rising from the lower-left section of the jersey. Trees and landscaping complete its base, integrating the monument naturally into the shirt rather than presenting it as an isolated graphic. A navy polo collar gives the design a more sophisticated, traditional character, while the red-and-white edge detailing reinforces the French theme. The AUFA crest introduces gold as a secondary accent, giving the upper chest a premium club-style finish. The back is considerably more restrained. A small French tricolour tab sits beneath the collar, followed by a large white player name and number with a fine red outline. Below the number, a fleur-de-lis framed by two thin red lines provides a final French heritage detail without overcrowding the composition. Overall, the concept combines Paris, French identity and classic football elegance: midnight navy, tricolour accents, the Eiffel Tower and fleur-de-lis are brought together in a clean polo-collar kit that feels more refined and representative than overtly graphic.
